content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the SGPGIMS Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download SGPGIMS Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: SGPGIMS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 17 vacancies are available - 2 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) - Forensic Medicine (under ATC), 4 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) - Trauma Surgery (under ATC), 1 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) - Psychiatrists (under ATC), 4 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) - Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation [PMR] (under ATC), 4 for Senior Resident (Hospital Services) / Junior Resident (Non-Academic) - Lab Medicine (Under Apex Trauma Centre), and 2 for Junior Resident (Non-Academic) - General Hospital.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by SGPGIMS?
faq.answer: SGPGIMS has announced a total of 17 vacancies for the posts of Senior Resident and Junior Resident. These positions are available on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for SGPGIMS recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the SGPGIMS recruitment is scheduled for 25 September 2026. Candidates must ensure they reach the venue on or before the reporting time.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Senior Resident / Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The specific eligibility criteria, including educational qualifications and experience, are detailed in the official notification. Candidates are advised to review it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for SGPGIMS recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Document Verification followed by a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the SGPGIMS located?
faq.answer: SGPGIMS is located in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. The exact venue for the walk-in interview will be mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of these documents, and recent passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification will contain details regarding age limits and any applicable relaxations for candidates belonging to reserved categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for SGPGIMS recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, which will provide a direct download link to the PDF.
